text: Whoever among you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand; and if he cannot, then with his tongue; and if he cannot, then with his heart, and that is the weakest of faith.
arabic: مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَرًا فَلْيُغَيِّرْهُ بِيَدِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِلِسَانِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِقَلْبِهِ، وَذَلِكَ أَضْعَفُ الْإِيمَانِ

text: The strong person is not the one who overcomes others in wrestling, but the one who controls himself when angry.
arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ

text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being in debt and from being overpowered by men.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

text: Wondrous are the affairs of the believer, for there is good for him in every matter. If he is happy, he thanks Allah, and that is good for him; and if he is harmed, he is patient, and that is good for him.
arabic: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ، وَلَيْسَ ذَاكَ لِأَحَدٍ إِلَّا لِلْمُؤْمِنِ: إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ

text: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am bound to my covenant and promise to You as best as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

text: No one whose deeds are entered into the scale will be heavier than good character. For indeed good character reaches the level of fasting and prayer.
arabic: مَا شَيْءٌ أَثْقَلُ فِي مِيزَانِ الْمُؤْمِنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ خُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُبْغِضُ الْفَاحِشَ الْبَذِيءَ

text: The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
arabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ

text: No fatigue, disease, sorrow, sadness, hurt, or distress befalls a Muslim — even the prick of a thorn — except that Allah expiates some of his sins by it.
arabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلَا وَصَبٍ وَلَا هَمٍّ وَلَا حَزَنٍ وَلَا أَذًى وَلَا غَمٍّ، حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا، إِلَّا كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ

text: The believer who mixes with people and endures their harm is greater in reward than the believer who does not mix with people and does not endure their harm.
arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي يُخَالِطُ النَّاسَ وَيَصْبِرُ عَلَى أَذَاهُمْ أَعْظَمُ أَجْرًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي لَا يُخَالِطُ النَّاسَ وَلَا يَصْبِرُ عَلَى أَذَاهُمْ

text: Allah says: I am as my servant thinks of Me. I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me inwardly, I remember him inwardly; and if he remembers Me in an assembly, I remember him in a better assembly.
arabic: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي، فَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي نَفْسِهِ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي نَفْسِي، وَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي مَلَإٍ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي مَلَإٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُمْ

text: The likeness of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not is like the living and the dead.
arabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ

text: Allah says: I visit My servant in his illness, and if he is patient and hopes for My reward, I give him in place of his worldly life and its family something better.
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَقُولُ: إِذَا ابْتَلَيْتُ عَبْدِي فَصَبَرَ وَاحْتَسَبَ، لَمْ أَرْضَ لَهُ بِثَوَابٍ دُونَ الْجَنَّةِ

text: Every one of my Ummah will enter Paradise except those who refuse. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, who would refuse? He said: Whoever obeys me enters Paradise, and whoever disobeys me has refused.
arabic: كُلُّ أُمَّتِي يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَبَى، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَأْبَى؟ قَالَ: مَنْ أَطَاعَنِي دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَقَدْ أَبَى

text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

text: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى

text: Allah wrote down the decrees of creation fifty thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, and His Throne was upon the water.
arabic: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ مَقَادِيرَ الْخَلَائِقِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِخَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ، وَعَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ

text: Indeed Allah is beautiful and loves beauty. He loves to see the effect of His blessings upon His servant.
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ، وَيُحِبُّ أَنْ يَرَى أَثَرَ نِعْمَتِهِ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ

text: When Allah wants good for someone, He afflicts him with trials.
arabic: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُصِبْ مِنْهُ

text: The Hour will not be established until a man passes by a grave and says: I wish I were in his place.
arabic: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَمُرَّ الرَّجُلُ بِقَبْرِ الرَّجُلِ فَيَقُولُ: يَا لَيْتَنِي مَكَانَهُ

text: Modesty brings nothing except good.
arabic: الْحَيَاءُ لَا يَأْتِي إِلَّا بِخَيْرٍ

text: How amazing is the affair of the believer! There is good for him in every matter. If something good happens to him, he is grateful, and that is good for him. If something bad happens to him, he is patient, and that is good for him.
arabic: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ، وَلَيْسَ ذَاكَ لِأَحَدٍ إِلَّا لِلْمُؤْمِنِ: إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ

text: The Prophet said to Muadh: By Allah, I love you. So do not neglect to say at the end of every prayer: O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in the best manner.
arabic: يَا مُعَاذُ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأُحِبُّكَ، فَلَا تَنْسَ أَنْ تَقُولَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ

text: Allah forgives my Ummah for the evil thoughts that occur in their minds as long as they do not act upon them or speak of them.
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَجَاوَزَ لِأُمَّتِي عَمَّا حَدَّثَتْ بِهِ أَنْفُسَهَا مَا لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمُوا بِهِ أَوْ يَعْمَلُوا بِهِ

text: I visited the Prophet during his sickness and he said: I have been given the like of which has not been given to any Prophet. I have been given the opening of the keys of the treasuries of the earth. I have been given the like of which has not been given to any Prophet before me, and victory during the life of this world.
arabic: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي مَرَضِهِ فَقَالَ: أُعْطِيتُ مَا لَمْ يُعْطَ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ، فَأُعْطِيتُ فَتَاحَ كُنُوزِ الْأَرْضِ

text: The believer is one who is beloved by Allah, and there is nothing more beloved to him than his Lord. He is content with Him, and there is nothing more beloved to him than His remembrance.
arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ مَحْبُوبٌ إِلَى اللَّهِ، لَا شَيْءَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ، وَهُوَ عَنْهُ رَاضٍ، وَلَا شَيْءَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ ذِكْرِهِ

chapter: Book of Traits of the Hypocrites
text: Whoever has these four characteristics is a pure hypocrite, and whoever has one of them has one characteristic of hypocrisy until he abandons it: when he is trusted, he betrays; when he speaks, he lies; when he makes a promise, he breaks it; and when he argues, he behaves in a very imprudent, evil, and insulting manner.
arabic: أَرْبَعٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ مُنَافِقًا خَالِصًا، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ حَتَّى يَدَعَهَا: إِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ، وَإِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَإِذَا عَاهَدَ غَدَرَ، وَإِذَا خَاصَمَ فَجَرَ

text: Shall I not inform you of the best of your deeds, the most pure of them with your Master, the highest of them in your ranks, better for you than spending gold and silver, and better for you than meeting your enemy and striking their necks and they strike your necks? It is the remembrance of Allah.
arabic: أَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَعْمَالِكُمْ، وَأَزْكَاهَا عِنْدَ مَلِيكِكُمْ، وَأَرْفَعِهَا فِي دَرَجَاتِكُمْ، وَخَيْرٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ إِنْفَاقِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ، وَخَيْرٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْ تَلْقَوْا عَدُوَّكُمْ فَتَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَهُمْ وَيَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَكُمْ؟ قَالُوا: بَلَى، قَالَ: ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ

text: Allah has not sent down any disease except that He has also sent down its cure.
arabic: مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ دَاءً إِلَّا أَنْزَلَ لَهُ شِفَاءً

text: No fatigue, disease, sadness, worry, hurt, or distress befalls a Muslim — not even a thorn that pricks him — except that Allah expiates his sins by it.
arabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلَا وَصَبٍ وَلَا سَقَمٍ وَلَا حَزَنٍ وَلَا أَذًى وَلَا غَمٍّ، حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا، إِلَّا كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ

text: Allah will gather the believers on the Day of Resurrection and will call out: Where are the people of virtue? They will rise and enter Paradise before the reckoning, while others are being called to account.
arabic: يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُنَادِي: أَيْنَ أَهْلُ الْفَضْلِ؟ فَيَقُومُونَ فَيُدْخِلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ قَبْلَ الْحِسَابِ

text: The Prophet said: Whoever would like to have his provision expanded and his life extended, let him maintain ties of kinship.
arabic: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ

text: The one who maintains ties of kinship is not the one who reciprocates. Rather, the one who maintains ties of kinship is the one who maintains ties even when they have been cut off.
arabic: لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلَ بِالْمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْوَاصِلَ الَّذِي يَصِلُ رَحِمَهُ إِذَا قَطَعَتْ

text: A man said: O Messenger of Allah, I have relatives with whom I try to keep ties, but they cut me off. I treat them well, but they treat me badly. I am patient with them, but they harm me. The Prophet said: If you are as you say, it is as if you are putting hot ashes in their mouths. Allah will continue to help you as long as you remain in that state.
arabic: قَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ لِي قَرَابَةً أَصِلُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُونِي، وَأُحْسِنُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَيُسِيئُونَ إِلَيَّ، وَأَحْلُمُ عَنْهُمْ وَيَجْهَلُونَ عَلَيَّ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: لَئِنْ كُنْتَ كَمَا قُلْتَ فَكَأَنَّمَا تُسِفُّهُمُ الْمَلَّ، وَلَا يَزَالُ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ظَهِيرٌ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا دُمْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ

text: The Messenger of Allah said: No Muslim is afflicted by injury or illness, or anything else, except that Allah expiates his sins, even a thorn that pricks him.
arabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ كَدٍّ وَلَا حَزَنٍ وَلَا نَصَبٍ وَلَا وَصَبٍ وَلَا أَذًى وَلَا غَمٍّ، حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا، إِلَّا كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ

chapter: Book of Piety and Softening the Hearts
text: The Prophet said: Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, do not turn your backs on one another, and do not undercut one another. Be, O servants of Allah, brothers. A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not oppress him, nor does he abandon him, nor does he look down on him.
arabic: لَا تَحَاسَدُوا وَلَا تَبَاغَضُوا وَلَا تَدَابَرُوا وَلَا تَحَاسَدُوا، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا، الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ: لَا يَظْلِمُهُ وَلَا يَخْذُلُهُ وَلَا يَحْقِرُهُ

text: The Prophet said: A Muslim is the brother of another Muslim. He does not oppress him, nor does he abandon him. Whoever helps his brother in need, Allah will help him in his need. Whoever removes a distress from a Muslim, Allah will remove from him one of his distresses on the Day of Resurrection.
arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ، لَا يَظْلِمُهُ وَلَا يَخْذُلُهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ كَانَ اللَّهُ فِي حَاجَتِهِ، وَمَنْ فَرَّجَ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ كُرْبَةً فَرَّجَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ بِهَا كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ

text: Allah created mercy on the day He created it, in one hundred parts. He kept ninety-nine parts with Himself and sent down one part to the earth. By that one part, all of creation shows mercy to one another — even a horse lifts its hoof from its young out of mercy.
arabic: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ يَوْمَ خَلَقَهَا مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ، فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً، وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الْأَرْضِ رَحْمَةً وَاحِدَةً

text: When you stand for prayer, pray as if it is your last prayer.
arabic: إِذَا قُمْتَ فِي صَلَاتِكَ فَصَلِّ صَلَاةَ مُوَدِّعٍ

text: The first matter that the servant will be questioned about on the Day of Resurrection is the prayer. If it is sound, the rest of his deeds will be sound. If it is corrupt, the rest of his deeds will be corrupt.
arabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَإِنْ صَلُحَتْ صَلُحَ سَائِرُ عَمَلِهِ، وَإِنْ فَسُدَتْ فَسُدَ سَائِرُ عَمَلِهِ

text: Actions are but by intentions, and every man shall have only that which he intended. So whoever migrated for Allah and His Messenger, his migration is for Allah and His Messenger. And whoever migrated for worldly gain or a woman to marry, his migration is for that which he migrated.
arabic: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ

text: The Prophet said: If the son of Adam had a valley full of gold, he would want two valleys. Nothing fills his mouth except dust. And Allah accepts the repentance of the one who repents.
arabic: لَوْ كَانَ لِابْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيَانِ مِنْ مَالٍ لَابْتَغَى وَادِيًا ثَالِثًا، وَلَا يَمْلَأُ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلَّا التُّرَابُ، وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ

text: The Prophet said: Be in this world as if you are a stranger or a traveler passing through.
arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ

text: The Prophet said: abstain from what is in the world and Allah will love you. Abstain from what is in the possession of people and the people will love you.
arabic: ازْهَدْ فِي الدُّنْيَا يُحِبَّكَ اللَّهُ، وَازْهَدْ فِيمَا عِنْدَ النَّاسِ يُحِبَّكَ النَّاسُ

text: The Prophet said: When a man performs ablution perfectly and then goes to the mosque with the sole intention of prayer, for each step he takes, Allah raises him one degree and removes one sin until he enters the mosque.
arabic: إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ الرَّجُلُ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ لَا يُنْهِزُهُ إِلَّا الصَّلَاةُ، لَمْ يَخْطُ خَطْوَةً إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً وَحَطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةً

text: The Prophet said: The one who seeks knowledge is like the one who is fasting and standing in prayer, and for the seeker of knowledge, Allah has made Paradise obligatory.
arabic: مَنْ يَطْلُبِ الْعِلْمَ فَهُوَ كَالصَّائِمِ الْقَائِمِ، وَقَدْ أَوْجَبَ اللَّهُ لِطَالِبِ الْعِلْمِ الْجَنَّةَ

text: The Prophet said: The virtue of knowledge is more beloved to me than the virtue of worship, and the best of your religion is piety.
arabic: فَضْلُ الْعِلْمِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ فَضْلِ الْعِبَادَةِ، وَخَيْرُ دِينِكُمُ الْوَرَعُ

text: The Prophet said: Whomever Allah wishes good for, He gives him understanding of the religion.
arabic: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ

text: The Prophet said: A Muslim whose three children die before reaching puberty, Allah will enter him into Paradise by His mercy for them.
arabic: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَمُوتُ لَهُ ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنَ الْوَلَدِ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحِنْثَ إِلَّا أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِهِ إِيَّاهُمْ

text: The Prophet said: When the son of Adam dies, his deeds come to an end except three: continuous charity, knowledge from which others benefit, and a righteous child who prays for him.
arabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الْإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ: إِلَّا صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ

text: The Prophet said: Whoever Follows a funeral procession, seeking reward from Allah, and prays over the deceased and follows it until burial, will return with two Qirat of reward. Whoever prays over the deceased and returns before the burial, will return with one Qirat.
arabic: مَنِ اتَّبَعَ جَنَازَةً لَا يُرِيدُ بِهَا إِلَّا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ تَبِعَهَا حَتَّى يُفْرَغَ مِنْهَا، فَلَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ، وَمَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ

text: The Prophet said: No one who has the weight of a seed of arrogance in his heart will enter Paradise. A man said: What about one who likes his clothes and shoes to be good? He said: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty. Arrogance is rejecting the truth and looking down on people.
arabic: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ، قَالَ رَجُلٌ: إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ ثَوْبُهُ حَسَنًا وَنَعْلُهُ حَسَنَةً، قَالَ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ، الْكِبْرُ بَطَرُ الْحَقِّ وَغَمْطُ النَّاسِ

text: The Prophet said: Do not get angry. The man repeated the question several times and the Prophet said: Do not get angry.
arabic: لَا تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لَا تَغْضَبْ

chapter: Book of Piety and Softening the Hearts
text: The Prophet said: Do not look down on any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
arabic: لَا تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ

text: The Prophet said: Whoever has a door in his house that he closes, his secrets remain his secrets.
arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ مَنْ أَمِنَهُ النَّاسُ عَلَى دِمَائِهِمْ وَأَمْوَالِهِمْ

text: The Prophet said: When a person dies, his soul follows his funeral, saying: O my family, O my children, do not let the world deceive you as it deceived me. I gathered for you what I could not eat, and I left it behind for you. Do not be like those who gather for the Hereafter while ignoring their worldly duties.
arabic: مَا مِنْ رُوحٍ تَمُوتُ إِلَّا وَهِيَ تَتْبَعُ جَنَازَتَهَا تَقُولُ: يَا أَهْلِي يَا وَلَدِي، لَا تَلْعَبَنَّ بِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا كَمَا لَعِبَتْ بِي

text: The Prophet said: A group of my Ummah will continue to fight for the truth, dominant, until the Day of Resurrection.
arabic: لَا تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ

text: The Prophet said: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.
arabic: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ أَنْفَعُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ
